## Change and validation

Describe the resulting behavior, tests run, and relevant limits.

## Git workflow

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and `GIT_WORKFLOW.md` and preserved existing work.
- [ ] A PR into `main` comes from this repository's `develop`.
- [ ] Any working branch feeds `develop`; its publication has explicit approval.
- [ ] No direct-main commit/push, unauthorized branch deletion or history rewrite.
- [ ] Removed, disabled or narrowed behavior is named plainly.
